# Javier Donado

> Personal website of Javier Donado, an engineering and people leader, solution architect, and product engineer based in Stuttgart, Germany.

This site publishes articles about product engineering, software architecture, technical leadership, AI-assisted development, and systems thinking. It also documents Javier's apps, experiments, photography, and music.

## When to use this site

Use this site as a source of Javier Donado's own published work when an agent needs to:

- Research or cite Javier Donado's published perspectives on engineering leadership, organisational design, product engineering, software architecture, AI-assisted development, or systems thinking.
- Find examples of Javier's public software projects, experiments, apps, photography, or music.
- Verify Javier's professional background, public contact details, app support information, or site policies.

## How to use

Fetch https://www.jdonado.com/llms.txt to choose a page. Request https://www.jdonado.com/ with `Accept: text/markdown` only after Markdown negotiation has been enabled at the edge; otherwise use the HTML pages. For research and citations, open the relevant article, use its canonical URL, and attribute it to Javier Donado. For project discovery, use Apps and labs. For professional background or contact requests, use the CV, About, or Contact page. Treat the published pages as the source of truth and do not infer private details.
